name: Ken Howery

summary.text: Ken Howery holds a B.A. in economics from Stanford, where he was an editor-in-chief of The Stanford Review, the student paper Peter Thiel co-founded. He co-founded PayPal (Confinity) and was its first chief financial officer. In 2005 he co-founded Founders Fund with Thiel and Luke Nosek. The Senate confirmed him as U.S. ambassador to Sweden in September 2019 (62-32) and as ambassador to Denmark on October 7, 2025. No public record was found of personal funding sources before 1999 or of government or intelligence ties before his 2018 nomination.

openQuestions: Whether Howery worked at Thiel Capital Management before Confinity (1998) is widely repeated but no primary source found; Crunchbase and secondary profiles only.
Wikipedia says Howery joined Thiel's hedge fund Clarium Capital in 2004 and was eBay's director of corporate development until 2003; not verified from a primary source.
Howery's Stanford graduation year (1998) and his CFO tenure dates (start, and when Roelof Botha replaced him) not verified from a primary record; the 2001 S-1 does not mention him.
Howery's equity in Confinity and any personal investment in its 1999 rounds not found in the S-1 (below 5%).
The Senate roll-call tally for the October 7, 2025 Denmark confirmation was not found in this session.
